thread:
jess (Support): Heads-up — customer acme-42 is seeing 403s that their frontend labels as "invalid API key", but server responses indicate a plan/feature gating denial. Happened right after they upgraded from starter -> pro. Repro steps I got from them:
1) curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ACME42" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ \POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '\"input\":\"hello\"'
2) Response: 403
   Body: {"error":{"code":"feature_not_enabled","message":"Embeddings not enabled for plan"}}
3) UI shows "invalid key" which is confusing them.

I collected the response headers and one ent-service log line below. Customer is blocked in prod, ticket #C-8472 already opened. Need quick triage and customer-facing fix.

sanjay (Eng): can you paste the raw request headers and the entitlement check correlation id? also include the auth-proxy logs and any x-Redwood-* headers. my first guess: plan-sync race between billing webhook and ent-service cache TTL.

jess (Support): headers they sent (sanitized):
```
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ACME42
X-Account-ID: acme-42
X-Account-Plan: pro
X-Request-ID: req_0f7a9b
User-Agent: acme/webapp/2.1.0
```
ent-service log (truncated):
```
[2026-03-16T09:02:10Z] INFO check_entitlement account=acme-42 req=req_0f7a9b plan=starter cache_hit=true source=billing_cache
[2026-03-16T09:02:11Z] WARN entitlement_denied account=acme-42 feature=embeddings reason=plan_mismatch
correlation_id=ent:5d9a1c
```

alex (Billing): I can see the invoice/payment for pro succeeded at 09:02:09 UTC, but our billing->account webhook to the account service errored (HTTP 502) and retried at 09:12:03. That means the account DB didn't get the plan flip until ~09:12. If ent-service read from the billing cache earlier, it'll still see starter. Looks like a 10-minute gap.

emily (Support Escalations): customer impact is high (stuck onboarding). Suggested short-term mitigation: allow a soft-fail path for embeddings for acme-42 for 30 minutes while we sync. We can flip a per-tenant override or add a temporary entitlement mapping. I can coordinate customer comms if we have the green light.

sanjay (Eng): root-cause hypothesis matches billing. Action items:
- immediate: set per-tenant soft-allow for acme-42 on ent-service (30m) so they can continue. (I can deploy a toggle now.)
- short-term patch: have ent-service check authoritative account DB when plan-change webhook present or when cache ttl shows recent change; avoid relying solely on billing_cache for 1st few minutes after a billing event.
- long-term: add a plan-sync-lag alert (>=5m) and retry backoff monitoring on webhooks.

oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1234 (plan-sync-out-of-sync). Priority: P2. Linked ticket: OPS-5487.

jess (Support): I applied the soft-allow and confirmed customer can now call embeddings (they reported success). Notified them and updated ticket C-8472.

emily (Support Escalations): I'll own the customer message and close the loop. Please add postmortem and follow-up engineering tasks: ENT-112 (avoid cache-only reads), MON-333 (plan-sync alert), BILL-220 (webhook reliability).

sanjay (Eng): I'll open ENT-112 and push a short hotfix to consult the account DB when a recent billing event exists. Also adding a monitoring rule for plan-change latency.

jess (Support): thanks all — moving to resolved for now, keeping incident open until billing webhook reliability is fixed.
